updates.title: Phase 0 foundation initiated
updates.summary: Repository, governance, book architecture, research systems, and dual Astro applications established.

updates.title: Phase 1 Declaration
updates.summary: First draft of the Declaration of Constitutional Capitalism published as the project's philosophical spine, with principles, objections, terminology, system comparison, and strengthened chapter outlines. Not a final ratified doctrine.

updates.title: Transition, testing, and ownership-middle-class architecture captured
updates.summary: Added argument-layer discipline, transition scenarios, national impact assessment agendas, prediction ledger, and a proposed Institute component. Predictions are labeled as predictions — not evidence.

updates.title: Measurability architecture: three books, baseline, CC Test
updates.summary: Captured three-book architecture (public book, Evidence Companion, Implementation Manual), National Baseline dashboard slots, chapter evaluation template, and the ten-question Constitutional Capitalism Test. Phase 2 reframed as evidence + baseline — structure only; no fabricated sources or baseline values.

updates.title: Civilizational core and living-project architecture
updates.summary: Captured power-distribution organizing principle, sacred sentence, subsidiarity acknowledgement, five pillars including Stewardship, living website IA (domains + life paths), corporation-as-partner framing, community economic sovereignty, and duty of constructive improvement. Canonical definition unchanged. Design agendas (permanent ownership/tax shift) remain open — not locked policy.

updates.title: Phase 1 accepted; Phase 2 diagnosis begun
updates.summary: Phase 1 closed (Declaration and foundational philosophy). Phase 2 opens the National Diagnosis, National Baseline, and Evidence Companion — evidence-building, not mass policy writing. Civic deliberation remains a parallel approved track.

updates.title: Phase 2 diagnosis foundation (partial)
updates.summary: Registered primary federal sources (Fed SCF/DFA, BLS, Census, USDA ERS, FDIC, CBO), upgraded 20 priority claims with supporting and contrary evidence, seeded Evidence Companion dossiers, wrote priority national-diagnosis briefs, sourced 2 baseline wealth metrics, and published /where-we-are, /evidence, and /metrics. Remaining domains queued for Phase 2.1. No invented statistics; modeling and legal review remain 0%.

updates.title: Justice, Safety, and Restoration as principal doctrine
updates.summary: Justice is now developing doctrine and a full Phase 2 research domain — the mechanism that makes liberty, ownership, opportunity, and accountability real. Architecture includes five stages, Justice Test, website domain with branches, and pending baseline indicator slots. Detailed justice policy remains blocked until sourced diagnosis. No invented statistics.

updates.title: Democracy as second constitutional spine
updates.summary: Democracy, Representation, and Distributed Government is now a second constitutional spine: trust and anti-entrenchment doctrines, party-as-association principle, Democracy Test, Bill Transparency Test, website domain with branches, and initial sources including Rucho v. Common Cause and NCSL institutional overviews. Detailed election and redistricting policy remains blocked until fuller Phase 2.1 diagnosis.

updates.title: Public service and institutional modernization doctrine
updates.summary: Public Service and the 21st-Century State is now developing doctrine and a full Phase 2 research domain: noble public service, automate-the-routine / elevate-the-human, visible boards, sunset/renewal, open appointments, citizen-centered services, Government Capacity Test, and Arkansas design agendas for a Public Authority Inventory and Civic Service Credential. No invented board counts; detailed administrative policy blocked until sourced diagnosis.

updates.title: Defining idea: invisible government, never unaccountable
updates.summary: Elevated public-service doctrine beyond more/less government. Defining question: better outcomes with fewer layers, less friction, greater accountability. New developing doctrine CC-DEV-025–028 covers friction reduction, the iconic phrase “Government should become invisible—but never unaccountable,” collect-once platform design, and AI that assists but never finally decides legal rights or significant benefits. Regulation Reason Test, citizen-experience metrics, and lean-government formula added. No invented 80/20 statistics or board counts.

updates.title: Constitutional Transparency and the People's Ledger
updates.summary: Fourth institutional spine: public information held in trust; presumed open unless constitutionally or legally justified protections apply; government generally bears the withholding burden. Named instrument: the People's Ledger. Includes agency dashboards, traceable statutes, open procurement and budgets, equal public-access terminals, careful identity rules for routine vs sensitive access, AI as records interpreter, and the Constitutional Transparency Test. Design agenda only — no invented FOIA or portal statistics.

updates.title: Essential Systems: design over predetermined conclusions
updates.summary: Major website and doctrine domain for banking, insurance, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, community health, and prevention. Shared constitutional question; four-question chapter method; Essential Systems Test; productive-value finance principle; health-as-strength and preventive-society goals; Community Health Index design agenda. Framed as incentive redesign — not inherent corruption. No invented sector statistics.

updates.title: Human Capital Doctrine and regional academy pilots
updates.summary: New pillar: deliberately build human capital infrastructure. First principle — every child deserves a meaningful pathway to productive adulthood through multiple respected pathways of equal dignity. Arkansas regional civic/innovation academies are a researchable pilot model (name undecided) organized by regional strengths, with paid apprenticeships, entrepreneurship, civic leadership, and flourishing metrics. Not a locked statewide design; no invented outcomes.

updates.title: Playbooks and the Community Operating System
updates.summary: Practical signature of the movement: adaptive community playbooks and a seven-layer living architecture. Build Your Community surface covers asset inventories, 25-year prosperity stages, Local Prosperity Engine (attract–keep–own), incubator-town patterns, and a permanent Implementation Completeness Rule. Community OS is a design agenda — not an operating product; no invented town growth outcomes.

updates.title: Community Safety, Justice, and Restoration
updates.summary: Justice elevated into a complete Community Safety and Restoration System: Community Safety Corps, relationship policing without arrest quotas, public corrections with no private financial interest in confinement, decision pathways A–E, secure restoration campuses, reentry from day one, Restoration Councils, and automatic transparency. Not merely softer or tougher on crime — more safety, more restoration, less discarded potential. Federal private-prison timeline recorded accurately (2016 Yates; 2017 Sessions rescission). No invented crime or recidivism statistics.

updates.title: Permanent Public Safety System — dignity under continuing custody
updates.summary: Rejects any category of citizens unworthy of reentry. For continuing extreme danger after due process and repeated review: publicly operated Secure Public Safety Campuses — humane permanent incapacitation with continuing review, graduated custody, productive contribution without private enrichment, resource concentration, rejection of exile, and anti-misuse safeguards. Risk scores alone never suffice. No invented custody statistics.

updates.title: Resource Sovereignty and Community Stewardship
updates.summary: Central doctrine: natural resources belong first to the place that bears extraction, consumption, congestion, pollution, and long-term risk. Community Resource Compacts, progressive essential-to-transformative pricing, Community Resource Dividend and Future Generations Fund, community equity, mining/data-center/warehouse rules, Resource and Pollution Ledger, Local Carbon Restoration Exchange with anti-fraud hierarchy, community-owned energy, and household energy floor. Compacts/Ledger/Exchange are design agendas; illustrative revenue splits require modeling; no invented resource statistics.

updates.title: Community Food Security System
updates.summary: Broadens food architecture from a single network idea into a Community Food Security System. Food is critical infrastructure. Principle: meaningful local essential-food capacity while remaining connected to broader markets. Explicitly rejects export-only rules for mass-produced staples. Includes Regional Food Networks, State Food Exchange logistics platform, local value-added production, waste reduction, emergency reserves, regenerative links, food education, and a Community Food Dashboard. Design agendas only; no invented food statistics.

updates.title: Phase 2 mission lock for Burt
updates.summary: Locks Phase 2 as the active proof mission: diagnosis restored; Evidence/Baseline absorbed as aliases; mandatory three-layer diagnosis briefs (data / inference / normative conclusion); acceptance criteria that reject scaffolding-as-completion; developing-doctrine capture clusters for post–Phase 1 ideas; system_interdependencies map. Phase 2 status remains PARTIAL. Civic deliberation stays approved parallel / not active. Modeling and legal remain 0%.

updates.title: Equal Standing Before the Constitution
updates.summary: Foundational principle: every person stands equal before the Constitution — equal protection and equal accountability, without engineered equality of outcome. Adds Blind Stage Principle (conduct before identity), Equality of Opportunity and Accountability, rejection of privilege in every direction, equal-access requirements, shared civic identity, and a seven-question Equal Standing Test. Distinguishes legitimate legal differences (age, conviction after due process) from status privilege. Iconic guide: The Constitution should hear the evidence before it sees the person. Architecture only; no invented access-to-justice statistics.

updates.title: Constitutional Citizenship Doctrine
updates.summary: Core doctrine: self-government requires education. Shifts the question from voting age alone to graduating every citizen prepared for responsible self-government. Democracy is a skill learned through experience — participatory civics, developmental pathway, Youth Leadership Councils (adults remain legally responsible), Civic Graduation portfolios, schools as community laboratories, civic service as contribution, and experience scorecards. Earlier local voting under certified preparation is a pilot-and-measure agenda only — not a declaration that voting begins at 16. No invented civics-outcome statistics.

updates.title: Viewpoint-neutral civic service
updates.summary: Strengthens Constitutional Citizenship with public-trust safeguards: civic participation, not partisan participation. Schools may recognize civic participation regardless of viewpoint but may not require support for any candidate, party, or policy as a graduation condition. Adds Civic Service Portfolio pathways, optional safeguarded political participation, reflection without predetermined conclusions, Civic Achievement Transcript, and the principle that government should encourage participation, not ideology. No invented civic-credit statistics.

updates.title: Constitutional Family Doctrine and Human Flourishing Index
updates.summary: Major pillar: children are the republic's greatest long-term asset; family-first care ladder; dignity-safe shared responsibility (rejects 'productive' as a worth test); no child should go hungry with state as last-resort guarantor; Family Wealth System; child flourishing measurement. Also locks living-philosophy identity, Systems Map, Knowledge Graph scaffold, and Human Flourishing Index as defining benchmark (Did human life improve?) — architecture only; Phase 2 remains PARTIAL; modeling/legal 0%; no invented childhood or flourishing scores.

updates.title: Constitutional Capitalism Assistance Doctrine
updates.summary: Major pillar: reject one-size-fits-all assistance; guarantee security while dismantling dependency; six pathways (permanent protection, childhood, caregiving, temporary stabilization, working-but-insecure, capable-but-disconnected); eliminate benefit cliffs; Human Prosperity Account and Prosperity Navigators; Community Work Guarantee as alternative to UBI; employer responsibility; asset-building; fair reciprocity; fraud without humiliation; honest exit measurement; Prosperity and Participation Centers. SNAP FY2024 scale sourced (41.7M / 12.3%); phaseout rates not invented; Phase 2 remains PARTIAL; modeling/legal 0%.

updates.title: Forensic audit now governs Phase 2
updates.summary: Locks forensic audit as operating authority: architecture ahead of evidence; canonical Phase 2 acceptance checklist; Burt steps 1–13 only; steps 14–25 deferred; three-layer brief enforcement via phase2:validate; baseline narratives reconciled to 86 metrics (2/86 remains visible); Phase 2 stays PARTIAL until checklist passes. Modeling/legal remain 0%.

updates.title: Public statistics bridge architecture (RedDirt → CC)
updates.summary: Queues CC-PHASE-2-PUBLIC-STATISTICS-BRIDGE-1.0: RedDirt remains Census/BLS ingestion host; isolated public_statistics boundary; CC consumes validated secret-free snapshots only; no campaign/operational data; no API keys in Astro/GitHub; first-wave 10–15 metric candidates mapped as design; import stubs + imports:validate. Baseline remains 2/86 until real validated observations land. Subordinate to forensic audit / Phase 2.1.

updates.title: RedDirt Civic Intelligence Platform (RCIP) vision
updates.summary: Formalizes RedDirt (H:\\SOSWebsite\\RedDirt) as the shared Public Data Engine for Constitutional Capitalism and future civic apps. CC must not duplicate Census/BLS connectors. Consumer contract is named validated measures plus full provenance. Campaign, public-statistics, and research data remain logically separated. Phase 2 still uses secret-free snapshots; baseline 2/86 unchanged by architecture.

updates.title: RCIP shared civic-data spine formalized
updates.summary: Formalizes RedDirt Civic Intelligence Platform as the shared civic-data spine: ingest/normalize/verify once; multi-source validation; four layers (raw, canonical, evidence/confidence, product projection); isolated schemas; CC as first external proof consumer with rich statistic display contract (source, confidence, disagreement, applications). Architecture only — baseline 2/86 unchanged.

updates.title: RCIP Phase 1 spine consumer bridge (PARTIAL)
updates.summary: Registers CC-DEC-079 / RCIP-PHASE-1-PUBLIC-STATISTICS-SPINE-1.0 consumer side: publicstats:import|validate|report; RedDirt spine audited and scaffolded. Live Census/BLS ingestion blocked by unusable keys in RedDirt env — no observations imported; baseline remains 2/86; progress not inflated by infrastructure.
